happy.name: Gulab Jamun
happy.description: Sweet, soft, and absolutely delightful — a joyful classic.
happy.recipe:
1. Mix khoya and flour
2. Make small balls
3. Deep fry until golden
4. Soak in sugar syrup

happy.name: Rasmalai
happy.description: Creamy, fragrant paneer soaked in sweetened milk — celebratory and light.
happy.recipe:
1. Make soft paneer balls
2. Cook in milk
3. Add cardamom and saffron
4. Chill and serve

happy.name: Mango Kulfi
happy.description: Silky mango frozen dessert — summery and joyful.
happy.recipe:
1. Blend mango pulp with condensed milk and cream
2. Freeze in molds
3. Serve chilled

sad.name: Chocolate Brownie
sad.description: Rich and fudgy — deep chocolate comfort food.
sad.recipe:
1. Melt dark chocolate
2. Mix with butter and sugar
3. Add eggs and flour
4. Bake until fudgy

sad.name: Warm Brown Sugar Pudding
sad.description: Soft, warm pudding — gentle and soothing for low moods.
sad.recipe:
1. Mix milk, sugar and custard powder
2. Cook until thick
3. Serve warm with a sprinkle of cinnamon

sad.name: Salted Caramel Ice Cream
sad.description: Sweet with a slight salt edge — small joy in every scoop.
sad.recipe:
1. Make caramel
2. Mix with cream and churn
3. Freeze until set

stressed.name: Ice Cream Sundae
stressed.description: Cool and indulgent — quick stress relief in a bowl.
stressed.recipe:
1. Scoop vanilla ice cream
2. Add chocolate sauce
3. Top with nuts
4. Add whipped cream

stressed.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
stressed.description: Warm cookies — crunchy edges and soft centers for a calming snack.
stressed.recipe:
1. Cream butter and sugar
2. Add flour and chips
3. Bake until golden

stressed.name: Matcha Latte Cake
stressed.description: A gentle, uplifting cake with subtle sweetness and calming matcha notes.
stressed.recipe:
1. Mix matcha powder into batter
2. Bake and cool
3. Serve with a dusting of matcha

energetic.name: Energy Balls
energetic.description: No-bake bites packed with nuts and oats for a quick boost.
energetic.recipe:
1. Mix dates and nuts
2. Add oats and honey
3. Roll into balls
4. Chill and serve

energetic.name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
energetic.description: Quick, sweet, and energizing — great pre-workout snack.
energetic.recipe:
1. Toast bread
2. Spread peanut butter
3. Top with banana slices and honey

energetic.name: Granola Parfait
energetic.description: Crunchy granola, yogurt and fruit — long-lasting energy and yummy textures.
energetic.recipe:
1. Layer yogurt, granola and berries
2. Drizzle honey
3. Serve chilled

sleepy.name: Warm Cookies
sleepy.description: Soft, warm cookies to wind down the day.
sleepy.recipe:
1. Mix butter and sugar
2. Add flour and chocolate chips
3. Bake until golden
4. Serve warm

sleepy.name: Warm Milk with Honey
sleepy.description: Simple and soothing — a gentle nightcap to calm you down.
sleepy.recipe:
1. Warm milk
2. Stir in honey and a pinch of cinnamon
3. Sip slowly

sleepy.name: Chamomile Tea and Biscotti
sleepy.description: Light, calming tea with a small biscotti for texture.
sleepy.recipe:
1. Brew chamomile tea
2. Serve with a small biscotti
3. Enjoy slowly
